run_structure_evaluation: run crystal structure evaluation against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen matching methods
create_ccdc_match_settings: create CCDC PackingSimilarity settings with configurable shell size, hydrogen ignoring, and molecular difference tolerance
match_single_structure: match a single predicted crystal structure against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
load_target_structures: load experimental reference crystal structures from CIF files into a dictionary keyed by reference code
compute_structure_matches: compute structure matches for all predicted crystal structures in a directory using CSD or pymatgen evaluation
